summary: Iteration 4 (conv favorite + delete): backend 9/9 pytest passed, frontend Playwright flows all green. Verified favorite toggle idempotency, cross-user 404 isolation for both /favorite and DELETE, favorite=true query filter, and multi-user isolation of filtered list. Frontend: star and trash icons on history-card do NOT propagate to open thread (stopPropagation working); filter-fav chip shows black bg + white filled star when active and correctly narrows list; open-thread-btn still opens thread; trash triggers confirm() and does optimistic removal; success toast 'Conversazione eliminata' shown.
critical_code_review_comments: ChatPage.jsx is ~415 lines and mixes chat, voice, history, thread and favorite/delete concerns; consider splitting HistoryCard and voice-recording logic into their own components/hooks for maintainability.
toggleFavorite/deleteConv use native confirm() and toast; acceptable for MVP but ideally use a shadcn AlertDialog for accessibility and consistency.
Backend GET /api/conversations accepts favorite as Optional[bool]; only `favorite=True` filters, `favorite=false` is a no-op (does not return non-favs only). Not a bug per spec but worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: Test creates transient conv_TEST_* docs and TEST users/sessions in Mongo, all cleaned up in fixtures/teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New endpoints POST /api/conversations/{id}/favorite and DELETE /api/conversations/{id} are working with proper 404 for unknown/cross-user. GET /api/conversations?favorite=true respects user_id. Frontend HistoryCard has data-testid: history-card, fav-btn, delete-conv-btn, open-thread-btn; filter chip data-testid=filter-fav. Playwright must set session_token cookie and register page.on('dialog', d.accept()) for delete confirm().
